feature_refactor_overlay_contract.purpose: Attach one clean Feature/Fix/Docs/Test/Reuse/Refactor entry to the Create Prompt without generated variants.
feature_refactor_overlay_contract.point_of_truth: Create Prompt tab entry inserted by Add selected entry; targets/mapping/build.complete remain write authority.
rules: Resolve create parameters before applying the overlay.
Extract only schema/boilerplate essentials; do not copy unrelated Project Root settings.
Use Build.complete or Start/Create scanned project evidence as write authority.
Do not create generated pseudo-scale variants.
Documentation entries must select exactly one PTB/WELMEC schema profile when PTB alignment is requested.
Testing entries must reuse existing test framework evidence or produce a manual gap.
Resource-reuse entries must inspect local candidates before creating new resources.

operator.label: Feature/Refactor Overlay Operator
rules: select one clean entry for the requested change type
